findings.title: Verify URL destination controls
findings.mechanism: A server fetches an attacker-selected destination.
findings.prerequisite: Untrusted input reaches this function and sensitive destinations are reachable.
findings.reasoning: The function uses the URL directly, but the fixture does not show its callers or network boundary.
findings.counterevidence: A request timeout exists; upstream destination validation may also exist but is not shown.
findings.action: Inspect callers and validate destination policy, redirects, and resolved addresses; restrict outbound access where appropriate.
findings.verification: In an isolated environment, test that prohibited destinations and redirect targets are rejected while permitted URLs still work.
